_readme: Hand corrections to the computed table. scripts/panchanga.py places a festival on whichever day
carries its tithi at 06:00 IST. That is not how observance is fixed: Ganesh Chaturthi goes by
madhyahna, Mahashivaratri by nishita, Diwali by pradosh, Janmashtami by midnight, most others by
sunrise. Sampling one instant gets roughly half of them right and puts the rest a day late.
Until the generator carries per-festival observance rules, this file is the source of truth.
moveFestival is what gets applied: festival slug -> year -> the correct date. The festival is
removed from wherever the table put it and placed on the date given. An empty object changes
nothing. Add an entry only when you have checked the date against a panchangam you trust.
_candidates is NOT applied. It is the list of dates where the computed table disagrees with a
published 2026 festival list, recorded so the checking has a starting point. Verify each against
the Pambu Panchangam, then move it up into moveFestival.
NalNaal shares this generator, so it shares these errors. A correction made here should be made
there too, or better, both should read one file.

_candidates.note: computed -> published. Unverified. Source: panchang.org 2026 festival list, Sep 2026.
